name: CET-6 英语六级核心词汇

words.example: The test results were abnormal.
Slavery was abolished in the 19th century.

words.meaning: adj. 突然的，意外的；唐突的
words.example: The meeting came to an abrupt end.
The concept is too abstract to understand.
His suggestion is completely absurd.
The region has abundant natural resources.
Drug abuse is a serious social problem.
She has an impressive academic record.
Economic growth has accelerated recently.

words.meaning: v. 容纳；向…提供住处；适应
words.example: The hotel can accommodate up to 300 guests.
The text is accompanied by illustrations.
We accomplished our goal ahead of schedule.

words.meaning: n. 账户；描述；v. 解释，占
words.example: Exports account for 30% of the economy.
Dust accumulated on the shelves.
The data must be accurate for the experiment.
He was accused of stealing the money.
He acknowledged his mistake publicly.
The company made a new acquisition.

words.meaning: adj. 充足的，足够的；适当的
words.example: The supply is not adequate for the demand.
We must adhere to the rules.
You need to adjust your study habits.
The university administration is efficient.
The company adopted a new strategy.

words.meaning: adj. 不利的，有害的；相反的
words.example: The drug has adverse side effects.

words.meaning: v. 提倡，主张；n. 拥护者
words.example: Many experts advocate for renewable energy.
The weather affects crop yields.

words.meaning: n. 总数，合计；adj. 总计的
words.example: The aggregate of all the costs is $10,000.

words.meaning: adj. 侵略的；有进取心的
words.example: An aggressive marketing campaign boosted sales.
The government allocated funds for education.

words.meaning: n. 替代选择；adj. 替代的
words.example: We need to find an alternative solution.
